text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, the academy is holding a party
as one of
its multiple promotional
events.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Look! Rudolf, Maruzen, and even C.B.
are here at
this party! What a dream
event!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, they'll be running an
exhibition
race after this! My heart is
racing a mile a minute,
as is my pen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This exhibition race is not one to miss.
Just as I'm thinking of how it'll be a
treasure trove for training reference,
someone speaks up next to
me.
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh. This night breeze is wonderful.
Makes me
want to go for a walk.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm? I'm going to take a little break.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's off before I can properly stop her.
The party will be ruined if one of its
main guests is missing. I
have to get her
to come back!
choice_data_list: Huh?! But then the race will—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Doo dee doo... Oh, that person must be
camping
solo. How nice. They've got a
portable wood
stove too...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You again? Didn't I just see you earlier?
choice_data_list: C.B., let's head back to the party!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, sorry but my body doesn't feel
ready to
go back yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Mr. C.B. effortlessly hoists
herself over
a bench and slides out of
sight down the staircase
handrail.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
What?
Is it really weird that I eat it this
way? I feel like it's tastier if you take
your first bite from
its back, though...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey again. Wow, you sure are
sweating.
Decided to get some exercise,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grumble...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Sounds like you've worked up a
killer
appetite. Well, I can't let you go
hungry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She shoves a piping hot taiyaki into my
mouth
while I'm panting for breath! Its
rich sweetness
washes over my tongue...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you dripping sweat is making me
want to
go running myself, so that one's
on me!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh. This evening breeze is so nice and
cool!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She runs off again in high spirits. I
stagger after
her, exhausted from my
wild Mr. C.B. chase.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not used to flat-out sprinting after
someone, and my party clothes are
ruined from all my
sweat. But despite all
that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find myself smiling at the frankly
delightful run and the fact that I just
decided to chase after her
without
thinking about it at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it isn't so bad to be dragged around
willy-nilly by someone so
unbarred and full of life.
Just as I finish
that thought...
choice_data_list: You're... right... That feels so good!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, I got a LANE message from
Rudolf... Ah,
it's almost time for the
exhibition race.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm all warmed up now, so I guess I
should
go.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, I'm going to head back now.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Here, you can have this. I bought it as a

refreshment for myself earlier, but I
haven't had
any yet.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You look ready to keel over the way
your legs are
wobbling. You should rest
a while before you get
moving again.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'll see you later! You should come see
the race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no keeping up with such caprice!
She's off
like a bullet once more, and I
trail after her with
tottering steps.
